lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgV2O5 crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Imm2 (No. 194), with a 16-atom unit cell containing Mg2V4O10 and four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers in a tetrahedral environment with four O neighbors, while V centers adopt an octahedral environment with six O neighbors; O centers are four-coordinate, surrounded by one Mg and three V neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg tetrahedra and V octahedra, as well as edge-sharing between V octahedra.
